reply.text:
POTS is a medical condition, so I'm not the right person to set cardio guidance around it. Please talk this through with your doctor or a physio who knows your case, and tell them you want to get back to cardio so they can say what is safe for you.

Once they've cleared what's safe, I'll build your cardio around it. Tell me what they say and what you want to get out of it, and I'll keep the training side moving from there.
